correctness.rationale: The disk extremum is reduced analytically to one unit-circle quadrant by the exact real-part formula for tanh and monotonicity in the imaginary coordinate. Subordination gives the universal half-plane inclusion, while the canonical Ma–Minda solution realizes the defining function itself and proves sharpness.
